turns.question: It's 12 October 2026. What are our sales in Germany so far this month?
turns.answer: For Germany (customer country DE) from 1 to 12 October 2026, Revenue (EUR) is 533.75 EUR and Net revenue (EUR) is 494.00 EUR; "sales" can mean either, so both are given under their metric labels. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
